proof_body:
by
  intro H
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Int.subgroup_cyclic H
  refine ⟨a.natAbs, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ha, ← AddSubgroup.zmultiples_eq_closure]
    rcases Int.natAbs_eq a with h | h
    · rw [← h]
    · rw [show ((a.natAbs : ℕ) : ℤ) = -a by omega, AddSubgroup.zmultiples_neg]
  · intro m hm
    rw [ha, ← AddSubgroup.zmultiples_eq_closure] at hm
    have h1 : m ∣ a.natAbs := by
      have : a ∈ AddSubgroup.zmultiples (m : ℤ) := hm ▸ AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples a
      exact Int.natCast_dvd.1 (Int.mem_zmultiples_iff.1 this)
    have h2 : a.natAbs ∣ m := by
      have : (m : ℤ) ∈ AddSubgroup.zmultiples a := hm ▸ AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples (m : ℤ)
      have h3 := Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.2 (Int.mem_zmultiples_iff.1 this)
      simpa using h3
    exact Nat.dvd_antisymm h1 h2
target_source: ∀ (H : AddSubgroup ℤ), ∃! n : ℕ, H = AddSubgroup.zmultiples (n : ℤ)
